screens.title: Four principles, before we plan anything

stops.question: Your first dashboard is rough. What now?

options.label: Wait until it is right, then start measuring
options.feedback: Waiting means no data. Start now and sharpen it every month.

options.label: Start measuring now, and sharpen it every month
options.feedback: Start badly rather than not at all, and sharpen it monthly.

production.lengthTarget: about 2:30: title card, four segments (one per principle), brand end
production.titleCard: Four principles, before we plan anything
production.note: Narration and keywords are taken only from slide 12 and its speaker notes. Spoken at a normal pace the narration alone runs about one minute; the rest of the 2:30 is the title card, the on-screen builds and the two stops. Longer narration needs new script, which Noy approves first.
rules: on-screen text = the keywords below only
Wawiwa brand colours and logo unchanged

segments.principle: Measure whether the goals were met, do not only act.
segments.narration: Measure whether the goals were met, do not only act. Activity is not evidence. If you cannot name the number that proves a goal happened, it was an aspiration.

segments.principle: Measurement starts tactical and intuitive, then matures into precise insight.
segments.narration: Measurement starts tactical and intuitive, then matures into precise insight. Nobody's first dashboard is right. Start measuring badly rather than not at all, and sharpen it every month.

segments.principle: Understand what works, what does not, which campaign failed, and which investment was profitable.
segments.narration: Understand what works, what does not, which campaign failed, and which investment was profitable. All four, not just the first. A plan that only reports successes cannot be optimised.
onScreen: All four, not just the first

segments.principle: Building the measurement infrastructure is a necessary step before any marketing activity begins.
segments.narration: Building the measurement infrastructure is a necessary step before any marketing activity begins. Set it up before the campaign. Data you do not collect today cannot be analysed in the future. Nobody sets up tracking retroactively.
